notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Incarnation Technique.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
